pages.title: A Proper Station
pages.text: Place a Display Board and an Advanced Display at your station.

pages.title: A Proper Station
pages.text: Give passengers useful display surfaces; the quest checks installation, not text accuracy.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use native display configuration to choose station information. A home-made timetable is welcome, but beauty and passengers are not scored.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use planks/dyes on headstocks or buffers, dye/soul materials on smokestacks, and a Wrench on boiler fronts. Change boards, color, smoke type and door style without changing train mechanics.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Craft or stonecut Station Platform blocks. Create platform edges sized for trains or subways.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Configure Advanced Displays for a station or train. Show arriving trains or upcoming stops.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Right-click an Advanced Display with a Wrench and choose information type/detail. Show station, destination or passenger information; native settings control line color, carriage index and repeated arrivals.
